title: The newcomer in his first weeks: he does not know the price, finds it, and tells the caller to just bring it by
purpose: People, slot 7, a month into the job. He has the greeting by heart and nothing else: he is not sure the shop does the work, puts the caller on hold to find the price, answers 'do I need an appointment' with the opening hours and takes no name.

call.day: the Wednesday of week T-10 (rule R6; people, call 13)

scenario.who_calls: A first-time caller from across the Georgia line, Earl Blevins, who is about to buy a used car from a private seller.
scenario.job: pre-purchase inspection with road test and written report
scenario.wants: to know whether the shop does it and what it costs
scenario.what_happens: Caleb thinks the shop does, puts the caller on hold for half a minute to find the price, gives it twice, says no appointment is needed and gives the opening hours, guesses the time it takes, offers to put him down and accepts 'I'll just come by'.

facts.note: catalogue.json pre_purchase_inspection: 149.95 for any class (a menu price), 1.5 hours. The price he finds is right: his two wrong prices are calls 12 and 9.

prices.what: Pre-purchase inspection with road test & written report

script.said: Brennan Auto Care, this is Caleb.
Yeah. Do y'all check out a used car before a fella buys it?
Yes sir! Uh — I think so. Yes sir, we do.
What's that cost?
Uh, I'm not sure on that one. Can you hold on one second? Let me look it up.
Go ahead.
[on hold, 34 s: music]
Okay, sorry about that. It's one forty-nine ninety-five. That's the pre-purchase inspection.
Okay.
A hundred fifty. And does it matter what it is? It's a Civic. A sixteen.
No sir, I don't think it matters. It's one forty-nine ninety-five.
Okay. Do I need an appointment for that?
Uh, no sir. I mean, you can just bring it by. We're open seven-thirty to five-thirty.
How long's it take?
Uh... I think like an hour? Hour and a half. Should be.
Alright.
You want me to put you down for something?
Nah, I'll just come by one day this week.
Yes sir, no problem. Have a good one!
You too.

why.price_with_next_step: 1: the right price, bare, after a hold; no step follows it.
